document.abstract: This standard specifies the packet format and transmission timing for DV-based 25 Mb/s, 50 Mb/s and 100 Mb/s data streams over an IEEE 1394 interface. This standard covers the source packet structure for transmitting the DIF blocks, the definition of a CIP header, the transmission order and timing, and includes information on both real time and faster than real time transmission.
